status: reviewed_for_deterministic_duplicate_screen; no source records accepted for training

screen.policy: Keep originals and source evidence in the archive; exclude exact historical matches from the new independent dataset. Historical records remain in their frozen splits.

candidate_internal_links.policy: Same-label copies can be deduplicated only after the source label and leaf annotation are accepted; conflicting labels stay quarantined until publisher metadata resolves them.

legacy_internal_links.action: Do not mutate the frozen historical v2 set; preserve as inherited limitation.

limits: A perceptual-hash or exact-decoded match is a duplicate screen, not a physical-plant identity claim. No disease label was inferred from pixels.
